newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bunds seen unnerved ahead of Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: German bunds seen unnerved ahead of Greenspan.

text.p: German debt and futures are expected to experience a degree of consolidation ahead of the start of U.S. Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony on the U.S. economy on Tuesday, dealers said.
Neither favourable German June M3 money supply data nor details emerging from an audit of French public finances earlier managed to put much life into a sluggish market.

"M3 did not help us, and France is not interesting because everyone thinks the euro is coming anyway, regardless what the figures (on state finances) are. In any case, people are afraid of what Greenspan will say this time," one dealer said.
